classification: descriptive calibration, not a candidate Elo estimate

definitions.hidden_attack: opponent legal capture of moved piece after our move; attacker source was hidden before our move
definitions.piece: knight, bishop, rook or queen; pawn=1, minors=3, rook=5, queen=9
definitions.down3: net material <= -3 at ply30, only games reaching that ply; early endings separately counted
definitions.reply_loss: capture on moved-piece destination with negative net material change across our move and the reply
definitions.reply_loss2: net material falls at least 2 across our fog-exposed piece move and the reply, regardless of which piece was captured
definitions.reply_loss2_after_our_next_turn: same net loss measured after our next move, allowing one recapture; longer combinations can still change it
definitions.causality: attacked moves can be sound sacrifices or exchanges; lower exposure alone is not stronger play

games.trace_caveat: retained stderr can be bounded; separate startup logs prove model load
